remarks: Sparkling, modern and just renovated, this totally revamped townhouse on 4 floors is in the prime of downtown New Canaan. Over 3500 sq ft and 3-4 bedrooms, 4 1/2 baths, outrageously gorgeous new kitchen and full movie theater, this special home is located in a small 5 unit complex within steps to the new library, vibrant town center, award winning restaurants, lush parks and train to NYC. Front to back entry w/refinished light H/W flooring leads to open floor plan w/dazzling new kitchen, generous eating island w/ quartz counters, high end stainless range, pot filler, built in microwave, 2 dishwashers, statement refrigerator and wet bar. The open living room has light H/W floors, built-ins and Fr door to private terrace. All new recessed lighting and light fixtures throughout. Separate formal dining room, renovated powder rm and attached garage complete the ground floor. 2nd floor has primary suite, 2 part walk in closet and stunning marble bath w/double sinks and shower and an office with walls of shelves and a separate laundry room. 3rd floor is a suite w/sitting rm, cabinetry and palladium window. Also a bedroom/den w/ skylight and new bath with shower. The LL is a recreational delight w/ full sized movie theater, specialty lighting, audio, entertainment center w/wetbar and frig, newly renovated full bath w/shower and exercise room/gym. Wireless Sonos sound system. Move right into this incredible home and enjoy luxury living with a wonderful new vibe.
